Which statement about the use of metals is correct?
A
Aluminium has a high strength and high density so is used to make aircraft.
B
Copper has a low melting point so is used in electrical wiring.
C
Aluminium is resistant to corrosion so is used in food containers.
D
Zinc is used to make the alloy stainless steel which is used in cutlery.

options.label: A
options.text: Aluminium has a high strength and high density so is used to make aircraft.

options.label: B
options.text: Copper has a low melting point so is used in electrical wiring.

options.label: C
options.text: Aluminium is resistant to corrosion so is used in food containers.

options.label: D
options.text: Zinc is used to make the alloy stainless steel which is used in cutlery.
